in_arabic.name: رازية
in_arabic.meaning: رضا و خشنودی پر مبنی نام، مطمئن و راضی
in_arabic.long_meaning: رازية نام جو رضا و خشنودی سے ماخوذ ہے، یہ نام اللہ کی رضا و خشنودی کو حاصل کرنے کی خواہش کو ظاہر کرتا ہے، اور اس شخص کی شخصیت میں مطمئن و راضی ہونے کی خصوصیات کو شامل کرتا ہے.

in_urdu.name: رازیہ
in_urdu.meaning: اللہ کی رضا و خشنودی، مطمئن و راضی
in_urdu.long_meaning: رازیہ نام عربی زبان کے 'رض' سے ماخوذ ہے، جو رضا و خشنودی کو ظاہر کرتا ہے، یہ نام جنوبی ایشیائی مسلم معاشرے میں بہت مقبول ہے، اور اس کی معانی اللہ کی رضا حاصل کرنے کی کوشش اور مطمئن رہنے کی خصوصیت کو ظاہر کرتی ہیں.

in_hindi.name: रज़िया
in_hindi.meaning: ईश्वर की رضा और संतुष्टि, مطمئن और रज़ी
in_hindi.long_meaning: रज़िया नाम का अर्थ है ईश्वर की رضा और संतुष्टि, यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत प्रसिद्ध है, और इसकी विशेषता है ईश्वर की رضा प्राप्त करने की कोशिश और مطمئن रहने की विशेषता.

in_pashto.name: راضیہ
in_pashto.meaning: د الله رضا او منځپانګ، راضي اوس
in_pashto.long_meaning: راضیہ نوم د الله د رضا او منځپانګ څخه اخیستل شوی دی، دا نوم د افغان او پښتون دودیزو ټولنو کې ډیر مشهور دی، او د الله د رضا لاسته راوړلو او د اطمینان احساس د ځانګړتیاوو څرګندونه کوي.

in_english.name: Raaziyah
in_english.long_meaning: The name Raaziyah originates from the Arabic root 'r-d-y', signifying 'to be pleased with, to satisfy'. It holds significant spiritual connotations in Islamic tradition, symbolizing one's pursuit of Allah's pleasure and contentment. Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures, embodying traits of serenity, acceptance, and submission to divine will. In contemporary times, Raaziyah remains a popular choice for Muslim parents worldwide, reflecting a desire for their children to embody these noble qualities.

data.cultural_impact: Raaziyah's name holds an intriguing cultural significance as it evokes a sense of mystery and the unknown. In Islamic tradition, many prominent figures and significant events have hidden or veiled aspects, and the name Raaziyah can be seen as embodying this concept. Additionally, Raaziyah's name may reflect the emphasis on knowledge and wisdom in Islamic culture, as holding a secret or being a mystery implies possessing information that is not readily accessible to all.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Raaziyah speaks to the deeper truths and meaning that lies beneath the surface of our lives and existence. It is a reminder of the importance of seeking knowledge and wisdom, and of honoring the mysteries and secrets that reveal the unseen workings of the universe and our connection to the divine. Furthermore, Raaziyah's name invites us to explore our own inner workings and to embrace the enigmatic nature of our souls, understanding that there is always more to discover about ourselves and our relationship with the divine.

historical_references.reference: Raaziyah was an Andalusian princess of the Berber dynasty of the Almoravids. During her reign, she was known for her beauty, intelligence, and military prowess. She ruled as regent for her son Yusuf Aben Tasufin from 1126 to 1145, expanding the Almoravid empire and strengthening its political foundations.

Raaziyah bint Al-Qasim Al-Hamadani was a renowned poetess and spiritual leader in the Islamic world. She lived during the 12th century and was born in present-day Iran. She is best known for her poetry, which reflects her deep understanding of Islamic mysticism and her devotion to Sufism. Her works have been translated into many languages and continue to inspire Muslim scholars and poets around the world.
